items.textToSpeech: For adults aged 18+, including those pregnant or lactating, the Tolerable Upper Intake Level for vitamin A is 3,000 micrograms of retinol equivalents per day, in the form of retinol and retinyl esters. Because the level may not adequately address the possible risk of bone fracture in particularly vulnerable groups, it would be advisable for post-menopausal women, who are at greater risk of osteoporosis and fracture, to restrict their intake to 1,500 micrograms of retinol equivalents per day.

The Tolerable Upper Intake Level is the maximum level of total chronic intake of a nutrient from all sources judged to be unlikely to pose a risk of adverse health effects in humans. For the European Union, Dietary Reference Values are published by the European Food Safety Authority Panel on Dietetic Products, Nutrition and Allergies. Is there anything else I can help you with?
